title: We: nous …-ons, I wonder
summary: nous (we) takes -ons, the first verb ending you actually hear: nous demandons, nous vendons, nous trouvons, nous perdons. It's the same for -er and -re verbs. se demander = to wonder: Je me demande si… (I wonder if…). comprendre = to understand: je comprends, il comprend.
points: Plural forms are the same for -er and -re verbs: ils demandent / ils vendent, nous demandons / nous vendons.
demander = to ask (for). se demander = to wonder (ask oneself): Je me demande. Nous nous demandons.
si = if: Je me demande si elle veut venir.
comprendre = to understand: je comprends, tu comprends, il comprend (the d is silent).
Before using a verb, check its ending (-er or -re). That tells you how it sounds.
drills: I wonder if she wants to come.
Je me demande si elle veut venir.
We wonder if you want to sell it.
Nous nous demandons si tu veux le vendre.
